criteria.description: A session beginning a transaction captures a stable snapshot of committed table rows.
criteria.evidence: `zig build test` includes `executor keeps read transaction snapshot stable across writer commit`, which begins a reader after a seed commit and verifies its snapshot sequence.
criteria.notes: Snapshot capture is implemented in `Session.begin` through owned `SnapshotTable` rows.

criteria.description: A reader with an active snapshot does not see rows committed after its BEGIN.
criteria.evidence: `executor keeps read transaction snapshot stable across writer commit` commits a writer row after the reader begins, then verifies the reader still sees only the seed row.
criteria.notes: The visibility order checks transaction overlay, then snapshot store, then current committed store.

criteria.description: After a reader commits or rolls back, later reads see the latest committed database state.
criteria.evidence: `executor keeps read transaction snapshot stable across writer commit` commits the reader transaction and verifies the same session then sees both committed rows.
criteria.notes: Session commit clears snapshots before the next read.

criteria.description: Writers can begin before each other commits and still land through deterministic commit ordering.
criteria.evidence: `executor serializes concurrent writer commits into deterministic sequence` begins two writers before either commits, commits both, and verifies both rows are visible.
criteria.notes: Commit serialization uses the database commit lock and sequence counter.

criteria.description: Commit sequence numbers increment once per write transaction and do not increment for read-only transaction close.
criteria.evidence: The MVCC tests assert commit sequence values after seed and writer commits; the reader close reports the current sequence without adding a write increment.
criteria.notes: `Session.commit` increments `commit_sequence` only when the session has table transactions.

criteria.description: Writer-local inserts, updates, deletes, views, procedures, joins, grouping, and vector queries continue to use the visible row source for the session.
criteria.evidence: `zig build test` passed the existing executor, query-source, aggregate, procedure, DDL, kernel, and adapted fixture suites after the MVCC change.
criteria.notes: The change preserves the existing query-source bridge by routing base-table scans through `scanRowsForTable`.

criteria.description: Snapshot tables own their table metadata so snapshot row stores do not depend on mutable catalog pointers.
criteria.evidence: `zig build test` exercises snapshot reads through `SnapshotTable`, which clones table definitions and attaches snapshot row stores to owned metadata.

criteria.description: The benchmark CLI reports a snapshot read/write metric alongside existing hot paths.
criteria.evidence: `zig build run -- benchmark --rows 20 --vectors 8 --dimensions 3 --operations 5` passed and reported `snapshot_read_write`.
